title: First molecular detection of Theileria haneyi infection in horses in Southern Spain
author: Francisco J. Mendoza
license_note: figshare article detail endpoint license.name: CC BY 4.0

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Collect blood from 222 equids (218 horses, 2 donkeys, 2 mules) suspected of equine piroplasmosis across 19 Spanish provinces.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from each blood sample using standard DNA extraction protocols.

steps.title: Detect T. haneyi by nested PCR
steps.instruction: Perform a nested PCR targeting the hypothetical protein gene of Theileria haneyi (GenBank accession MT896770.1) on each DNA extract.

steps.title: Detect T. equi by nested PCR
steps.instruction: Perform a nested PCR targeting the EMA1 gene of Theileria equi on each DNA extract.

steps.title: Amplify and sequence EMA11
steps.instruction: For samples positive for T. haneyi, amplify the EMA11 gene, send the PCR product for sequencing, and obtain the nucleotide sequence.

steps.title: Align EMA11 sequences
steps.instruction: Generate nucleotide alignments of the EMA11 sequences using ClustalW, comparing them to the reference isolate U.S. Eagle Pass.
